parent_status: FROZEN — NEGATIVE CEILING for generic payload-agnostic architecture
ceo_directive: Do not reopen the generic #2 architecture merely to rescue the territory. Create a distinct branch such as #2-LARGE_PAYLOAD_RETENTION with its own engineering/IP/robustness tracker. The portfolio should only count it toward the eventual ten if that narrower branch becomes a genuinely functional, buyer-relevant invention.

scope.what_is_in_scope: Size-selective filtration for LARGE THERAPEUTICS only (antibodies 150kDa+, gene vectors ~5MDa, nanoparticles ~10MDa)
scope.what_is_out_of_scope: Generic payload-agnostic retention ( peptides <50kDa, small molecules <1kDa) — these failed in parent #2 NEGATIVE_CEILING
scope.patient_conditions: NOMINAL only (CSF production 0.3 mL/min, normal protein, no meningitis)

rationale: Per #2 final adjudication (V-final): multi-mechanism Pareto-DOMINATED by hydrodynamic for small payloads. BUT size-selective filtration alone ACHIEVES buyer threshold for large therapeutics at nominal conditions, acute duration. Patentable as narrow sub-invention. §102 SURVIVES per corrected matrix; §103 UNCERTAIN for Combo 3.
limitations_acknowledged: Fails T3 robustness (extreme patient variability drives retention to zero)
Cannot serve patients with hypersecretion / meningitis / severe fouling
